fields.v: Two opposing biases in the 23.0% estimate: two-snapshot design misses references added after the first commit (deflates); broad regexes match non-code tokens, 36% false positive or ambiguous (inflates); single annotator, no agreement; public GitHub only. Gaps (roadmap): RQ1 taxonomy of context rot; RQ2 transfer of comment, API-doc, architecture and installation checkers (e.g., MCP tool descriptions); RQ3 which forms of rot affect assistant behaviour (controlled experiments with injected rot); RQ4 repair (deterministic detection + LLM repair) and prevention
